Read out of the title on the name link behind his place in the line for 11 апреля ст. ст., name page 2162, «Фармуфий Египетский, пустынник», with the rank word left off. The day’s own line gives the name in the genitive. `.tmp/sr-foldpred.mjs` reports the stored form as a key no other folder holds.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 11 апреля ст. ст. — «Прп. Фармуфия (IV).»
source.note: A bare line with a century and no more. The name link behind it gives the country and the manner of life, «Фармуфий Египетский, пустынник», and the life page behind it is one sentence long.

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 11ης Απριλίου — «Όσιος Φαρμούθιος ο Αναχωρητής»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives him no years. The whole body of the page is one sentence: «Ο Όσιος Φαρμούθιος απεβίωσε ειρηνικά». The corpus holds nobody else of this name, so there was no namesake to weigh. The page prints no relic and no hymn; its couplet plays the name against the Egyptian month Pharmouthi, which it glosses as April.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).

floruit.note: days.pravoslavie.ru’s life: «Преподобный Фармуфий жил в IV веке в той же пустыне, где подвизался в студенце (колодце) преподобный Иоанн (память 29 марта), которого питал святой Фармуфий»; the day line gives «(IV)». The page says he *lived* in the fourth century, so this is recorded as a floruit and not as a death; the folder held no `dates` at all before, because saint.gr gave no year. Read 7 October 2026.
